top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic UCI Gravel Chile's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
UCI Gravel Chile's Lakeside gravel, Northern Patagonia forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 62 miles.
When someone attacks on fast lakeside and rural gravel around Lago Ranco, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
UCI Gravel Chile's fast lakeside and rural gravel around Lago Ranco rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At UCI Gravel Chile, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
62 miles on fast lakeside and rural gravel around Lago Ranco burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
2-minute all-out efforts on fast lakeside and rural gravel around Lago Ranco. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of UCI Gravel Chile. Train it until it feels boring.
At UCI Gravel Chile, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what UCI Gravel Chile's fast lakeside and rural gravel around Lago Ranco actually does to you.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Varied gradients on fast lakeside and rural gravel around Lago Ranco demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for UCI Gravel Chile’s 62 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at UCI Gravel Chile requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on fast lakeside and rural gravel around lago ranco to build confidence. Expect: lakeside gravel, northern patagonia, fast rolling loop.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Gravel Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 62 miles of fast lakeside and rural gravel around lago ranco in Lago Ranco, Los Ríos Region, Chile.
